svg.title: Kaelith69 contribution reef
svg.desc: 864 GitHub contributions from 2025-11-20 to 2026-11-19. A white reef fish follows a rounded, eased route to each active contribution organism. A color shifting octopus rests on the sandy seabed beneath a living reef with drifting plankton, jellyfish, kelp and underwater light.

g.text: A YEAR OF BUILDING BELOW THE SURFACE
